answer: Bind each replica identity to bonded stake, collapsing an ocean of Sybil personas into measurable collateral rather than headcount. With n = 3f+1 nodes, any two commit quorums of 2f+1 intersect in at least f+1 members, guaranteeing an honest witness that forbids conflicting states. A slashing penalty exceeding rewards makes the expected attack utility of each equivocating cipher negative, while a zero-knowledge verifiable-delay proof blocks grinding. Honest consensus is a Nash equilibrium, deviation forfeiting stake to ferrous finality.
